name: Arrow Squall
body:
School evocation; Level magus 5, sorcerer/wizard 5

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (one piece of non-magical ammunition)

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft + 5 ft./2 levels) Area 10 ft. radius spread
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Reflex half; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

You summon dozens of magically replicated pieces of ammunition that rain down on your enemies, dealing 1d8 points of damage per caster level. The type of damage is same as the ammunition used as the material component for the spell.
